{{Top|leg}}
An '''electromagnetic shield''' was a type of shield used to deflect [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. The [[SkyBlind]] manufactured by [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]] employed electromagnetic shields in conjunction with [[Sensor mask (starship technology)|sensor masks]] and [[optical shield]]s.
